column1: # Wayback Machine captures for faculty_directory.py, fetched by Dockerfile.web.

# URLs and timestamps only. The pages themselves are 2016 faculty directory
# entries (names, offices, phone numbers, email addresses) and this repository
# is public, so they are fetched into the image at build time instead of being
# The first row is the directory the script starts from: the last capture before
# the homework's 2016-04-11 submission. Every other row is the capture closest
# to that date for the faculty page the 2016 XPath extracts from it — 32 links.
# Most are from April 2016; a few pages were not crawled then, and their nearest
# capture is as late as August 2017. projects/python-hw4.html says so.
# `id_` in the fetch URL asks the Wayback Machine for the original bytes, without
# its toolbar and link rewriting, so the 2016 XPath sees the 2016 markup.
